name: ai-website-security-platform
description: AI-Powered Website Security Assessment, Attack-Surface Monitoring, and Incident Recovery Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm --prefix packages/security run build && npm --prefix packages/scanner-core run build
scripts.build:apps: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/worker run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
